verdict.rationale: Shopify Agentic Commerce/UCP is a retail commerce protocol for AI agents to search catalogs, build carts, and complete merchant checkouts — it is not an API/service monetization mechanism using HTTP 402 per-call machine payments. Nothing in the evidence describes HTTP 402 status-code payment flows, API paywalls, or per-call agent billing; all payment/checkout flows described are tied to merchant cart/checkout sessions for buying goods, a different axis than developer API monetization.
